title: Junket
summary: JUNK'ET, noun [See Juncate.] A sweetmeat. 1. A stolen entertainment. JUNK'ET, verb intransitive To feast in secret; to make an entertainment by stealth. 1. To feast. Job's children junketed and feaste

inlines.v: JUNK'ET, noun [See Juncate.] A sweetmeat. 1. A stolen entertainment. JUNK'ET, verb intransitive To feast in secret; to make an entertainment by stealth. 1. To feast. Job's children junketed and feasted together often.
